flagged.title: Spring Offensive, Hundred Days and Armistice
flagged.reason: The video presents the old, reversed sequence and false causation where Haig's 'backs to the wall' order (11 April) causes the appointment of Foch as Generalissimo (26 March), which would cost marks on exam questions covering the Allied unified command.

mark_affecting.quote: In response to this terrifying German advance, British commander Haig issues his famous 'backs to the wall' order. This crisis essentially forces the Allies into something they really hadn't done before: true unity. They appointed French Marshal Ferdinand Foch as Generalissimo.
